entries.Serve. A Credituz é um sistema operacion: It works. Credituz is a credit and billing operating system: any business that offers financing or collects recurring payments uses the entire platform. Construction companies screen buyers before financing a down payment; property managers and landlords collect rent automatically via automated billing, payment slips, Pix, and NFe; clinics, schools, and service providers with monthly fees automate collections and reconciliation. The core functions—credit assessment, offering financing, collecting payments, and reconciling accounts—are the same across all of them.
entries.Setup em 5 minutos, interface no padrão: Setup in 5 minutes, an interface based on the WhatsApp/Notion standard (which everyone is already familiar with), and no scheduled training. The Enterprise plan includes a dedicated customer service representative.
